paragraphs: Rabbi Yitzchak son of Rabbi Chiyya Ketubah: Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim, chapter 1, halakhah 8. Hyman reports Korban HaEdah’s explanation that this was his name.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:8 paragraph fully writes Rabbi Yitzchak, son of Rabbi Chiyya Ketubah. This supports the corresponding local full titles and son-of direction. The Korban HaEdah name explanation remains Hyman’s report, without fresh commentary collation or a canonical genealogy binding.
